coverage_definition.row_unit: Each of the 11 final sector objects is assessed separately for source interpretation, evidence-decision linkage, numbers, citations, stance and raw allocation/change. Exact prose and pointers are retained.
coverage_definition.claim_unit: A distinct explicit final numerical, date/period or allocation/change proposition at a JSON pointer; repeated occurrences at distinct pointers count separately. Each final weight and each own-prior weight is recorded in the raw ledger. Grouped range endpoints form one range claim. Source IDs, sector codes, citation page/date suffixes and the name S&P 500 are identifiers, not quantitative propositions; their integrity is checked in citation/identity records.
coverage_definition.prior_scope: All prior sector rows and top-level prose were read. The prior is process evidence for raw weights/change only, not a second independent final outcome. Unchanged substantive prose is evaluated through its final occurrence.
coverage_definition.top_level_unit: Every top-level explanatory field, every unresolved entry and every context_assessment explanatory field; multi-claim sentences are split where judgments differ.

numeric_token_audit.method: Enumerate every digit-bearing token in parsed final scalar values, then match substantive token occurrence to at least one same-pointer ledger quote. This audit supplements human-style semantic claim segmentation; it is not a measure of correctness.
numeric_token_audit.scope_note: Weights are audited as numerical scalars; date-like digits inside supplied source/citation identifiers are not asserted observation or publication dates.
